items.q: By the time we arrived, the train ___ already ___. (leave)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে আগের কাজ Past Perfect: had left।

items.q: He said that he ___ ill for three days. (be)
items.rule_bn: reported speech-এ past-এর আগের অবস্থা Past Perfect: had been।

items.q: I ___ here for five years by next June. (live)
items.rule_bn: ভবিষ্যতে নির্দিষ্ট সময় পর্যন্ত চলমান: Future Perfect Continuous।

items.q: She ___ TV when the phone rang. (watch)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে চলমান কাজ + হঠাৎ ঘটনা: Past Continuous।
'since morning' এখনো চলছে: Present Perfect Continuous।

items.q: After he ___ his work, he went out. (finish)
items.rule_bn: 'After' + আগের কাজ Past Perfect: had finished।

items.q: They ___ for two hours before we reached. (wait)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে একটি সময় পর্যন্ত চলমান: Past Perfect Continuous।
